items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Ed Fontana, Charlie Hartman. All these guys are dead.

ctx.x: How long was Forbes' band in the Sanger? About nine months.
Uh-huh. Nine months or so. This is Louie Primer. Uh-huh. Yeah. Ed Fontana, Charlie Hartman. All these guys are dead.

Ed Fontana, any relation to Carl Fontana? No. No. No, no, no. Hector Fontana is his son. Ah, okay. Now, Leo Forbstein. That was his brother. His brother. Was he ever involved down here? No. Did he ever come here? No, no.
